detail.longDescription: It's quite astonishing how many bugs keep popping up in GitHub these days, considering it's an established service by a major tech company. Stuff that always worked fine keeps breaking. Recently they broke creating milestones, and links to milestones are still broken in places. Now they've broken comments, where lists sometimes render with the wrong bullets, and quoting has been completely broken for several days. We all know why of course: this is slop. # AI # Slop # GitHub # Microsoft
